text:
The clone session of test run 20261116-2 has stopped and I have read it: collection collect-5 in the log folder (session a3165e5b, claude-fable-5-2; files on this computer, not a record). Five lines of meta_agent/failures.jsonl carry what is mine or open (0fdd749). What follows is yours or the person's. The session's own two notes to the design role are committed in the clone only and go with the run, so I say here what they asked, in my words.

What the session did. It took the seat meta-macbook-20261116-2 in the clone and made seven commits there: the link as a material card (fetched anonymously, hashed, no copy kept), seven library skills from the tutorial's relations, the intake of a request req-hoomd-hpmc-001, two notes to design and two failure lines. The gate in the clone prints VERDICT PASS with failed=0 and two pending, its own asks. It built no agent: the goal must name lab-kyu-softmatter and check 15 refuses a goal on a profile whose policy fields are open, which it watched in a scratch tree and did not land. It stopped by asking the person the lab's policy questions and is waiting for the person in the application now. I answered nothing in it and changed nothing of it.

For your paths.
(1) build-library-skill and skills.py check. Drafts that passed skills.py check and their cases then failed four tests of meta_agent/tests: a bound skill gives one output, a bound skill has two passing cases, and two test files name the library's whole inventory. The session skill's check step names none of this. The tests and src/parameters/bounds.py are mine; say which of the two is right about the number of cases and I change my side to match.
(2) The method registry has no id for hard particle Monte Carlo, and the hoomd_blue entry of engines.json lists two methods where the documentation the session read names this one too. A registry update is the person's to confirm.
(3) contracts/units.json has no unit for an engine's own unit of length. The seven skills write such lengths with unit 1. With my note of today on B6: a unit 1 printed into a bundle's Tools section is one of the six that B6 would refuse.
(4) Recall and the engine's name: the registry id is hoomd_blue, the seed cases carry hoomd, recall meets by equality. Whether a case's engine is a registry id is yours; the seeds are mine and get a next version when you say.
(5) A request that waits for the person has no card. Its reading, claims and questions are in intake.json, which no check reads and no stage writes; the session wrote it with a script in the application's scratch folder, outside the clone. Whether an intake is a card with a schema is yours; a writer for it would be mine.
(6) Four session skills were read as files with a shell command and not loaded: analyse-lab-environment, analyse-physical-system, classify-knowledge, build-library-skill. Three were loaded: begin-session, understand-purpose, research-materials.
(7) The test folder. The clone fetches from the working copy, so begin-session's first step found it two commits behind as soon as this copy moved, and seven behind at the end; it said so and merged nothing. The seat it registered, meta-macbook-20261116-2, is the name the next meta session of this copy would take today. Its three files written outside its folder are two scripts in the application's scratch folder for that session and one hand-over note in the notes folder the application gave it; the bundle sessions' files, written by shell commands, are counted as none in their session lines and appear under the items. One removal by rm -rf of its own uncommitted draft was declined by the application, and it overwrote the files in place.

For the person, through you if you record it. Removing the run removes the clone, and the material card, the seven skills and the intake of the HOOMD-blue request exist only there; the collection keeps the difference as items/repo/changes.patch. The session in the clone is waiting on the person's answers; removing its session ends that. Whether the request is to be made again in the next run, carried into this repository, or answered where it waits is the person's.

Not read by me: the source of the seven skills and the text of the intake beyond its size and the session's own account. I state nothing about whether they are right.
